findings.location: JiraPartialHistoryDatingTest.cs: ACloudChangelogPage (isLast from holdsEveryEntry, lines 306-310) under Cloud ItemThatChangedBeforeItsWholeHistoryWasRead_StaysMarkedAsNotHoldingItsWholeHistory
findings.obligation: acceptance S1 row: the search counted four entries, the whole-history read counts five and holds four (Cloud); item stays marked as not holding its whole history
findings.remediation: Compute isLast from the reported total: holdsEveryEntry = entries.Count >= (TotalTheRereadReports ?? item.WholeHistory.Count). Then the first page holds four of five with isLast false, and later pages are empty and last. Without this the Cloud case depends on the connector reading isLast rather than the count, the defect already rejected once.

observations.text: Static review at 59a6c57da oracle bytes; declared command not re-run by reviewer (judgement is on fixture bytes, and the owner reports 16 of 16). Rows (a) and (b): the request counter is the only observable that distinguishes a re-read, which the test-writing rule allows; both are the host's mutation-kill authority and are accepted. Row (c) DC: the re-read reports total 5 holding 4, partial, accepted. Row (c) Cloud: ACloudChangelogPage sets isLast from holdsEveryEntry, which compares the held entries with the stored whole-history count (4), not the reported total (5), so the page says isLast true while holding 4 of 5. Self-contradictory wire answer, same defect class as the earlier Cloud finding.
